name: comic-text
title: Comic Text
blurb: Text styled like a comic book headline with thick stroke, skew, and dot-pattern…
description: Renders text in a comic book aesthetic with black text stroke, skewed transform, drop shadow, red dot pattern fill, and a spring-based entry animation.
use_when: A playful or onomatopoetic heading wants a bold, retro comic book appearance.
a11y: Text content is visible but styled with WebkitTextFillColor: transparent. Background pattern is purely visual.
